description:
Move ORBGRAND reliability ordering onto the canonical magnitude permutation while preserving decoder behavior.

## Background

ORBGRAND currently owns a private ascending `Llr`-magnitude index sort. The shared total order removes that duplicate without changing logistic-weight pattern semantics.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Obtains ascending reliability indices through the canonical `Llr` convenience wrapper.
- [hard] REQ-02: Preserves hard-decision, query-order, candidate, and stopping behavior for finite inputs.
- [hard] REQ-03: Covers tied magnitudes, signed zero, and infinite LLRs through ORBGRAND regression tests.
- [hard] REQ-04: Contains no private reliability comparator duplicating the canonical helper.
title: ORBGRAND reliability migration
